name: 過去の比較期間を選ぶ一覧
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One actual catalog component only, no dashboard or presentation board.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: ORIGINAL source images have priority for icon glyph geometry, proportions, stroke/optical weight, alignment, spacing, small controls and visible states. Native mock is SECONDARY for Japanese adaptation and isolated component composition; correct its rough substitutes and omissions against the original. The approved bus image is a style reference only, not content.
Official Lighthouse design: pure-white#FFFFFFpage/canvas; white surfaces; fine neutral borders and restrained soft shadow only where a real container exists. Forest-green brand#1F6444with smooth#174C36to#2D8F5Egradient on actual primary/selected controls. Supporting icons coherent slate#526173, no random decorative hues. Use only evidence-backed semantic accents. No broad mint wash, glow or plastic gloss. Preserve Japanese Meiryo typography: headingBold20/28, bodyRegular14/24, metadataRegular12/16, zero tracking; retain role-specific distinctions and normal-weight body. Preserve all actual values, content, controls, artwork and visible states. Do not invent metrics, features, logos or watermark. Apple Design: purpose, compact readable hierarchy, precise alignment, clear state and restrained material. This static raster does not prove interaction, editability or owner acceptance.
Input roles: Image1: original-source-primary-details; Image2: component-preview-secondary; Image3: approved-style-reference
One Japanese comparison-period menu,390x276logical landscape, compact white rounded menu with fine neutral edge and soft elevation. Heading 比較する期間. Exactly5two-column options with precise ORIGINAL end dates: 前日 — 終了 2024年12月15日; 前週 — 終了 2024年12月9日; 前月 — 終了 2024年11月16日; 前四半期 — 終了 2024年9月16日; 前年 — 終了 2023年12月16日. Correct our mock repeated12月15日 for everyrow: source dates above are authoritative. Left labels14/24Regular dark, right dates12/16Regular subdued gray, consistently right-aligned. Keep each option on one row with ample room for full Japanese dates, no clipping. Quiet inset neutral divider below fifthrow, then right-aligned forest-green text action 比較する日付を指定. Do not add checkmarks, selectedrow, calendaricon, arrows or metric. Heading20/28Bold, all other text normalweight, zero tracking. Original controls menu anatomy, row spacing, datevalues and rightalignedfooter. Preserve Japanese labels and actual no-selection-visible state. No green divider, broadmint, extra controls, logo or watermark.
Evidence-based accent decision: Original popup itself neutral; triggerblueoutsidecomponent. Forestgreen only for customdate textaction, no coloredrow or additionalaccent. Preserve normalweight dates.
reviewNotes: 原画Amplitudeの5期間と個別の終了日を優先し、モックの全行12月15日という誤記を修正。生成を目視し前日2024年12月15日、前週12月9日、前月11月16日、前四半期9月16日、前年2023年12月16日を確認。比較する期間、右整列の比較する日付を指定、白面・中立区切り・通常太さの日付、欠落クリップなし。色は日付指定だけ森林緑。所有者承認・フォント実体・編集可能性・実装未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
